title: [Bug Fix] #249: Raise populated ErrorInfo for Subscription Billing failures
summary: Subscription Billing error handlers now raise the fully populated ErrorInfo object instead of plain-text errors, enabling interactive users to navigate to the offending record when document creation fails.
key_points: DisplayOrLogErrorFromBillingTemplate and DisplayOrLogErrorFromBillingLine now call Error(ErrorTextInfo) instead of Error(ErrorText)
The ErrorInfo already held the error type, message, RecordId, SystemId and TableId but was previously discarded
Interactive users now get an error with a navigation link to the offending Billing Template or Billing Line
Added a regression test in codeunit 139688 checking that an ErrorInfo-based error is raised
Automated billing still logs errors without raising an interactive error
